protocol.long_sequence_policy: drop the row from every representation
protocol.splits: shipped MoleculeACE train/test split, used verbatim
protocol.head: XGBoost, hyperparameters shared across all representations
protocol.validation: 20% of the train split, seeded, for early stopping (50 rounds); refit on the full train split with the selected tree count
protocol.note_pooling: dense_max vs sae_max is the primary like-for-like comparison. dense_mean vs sae_mean is the matched mean-pooling sensitivity analysis; dense_mean vs sae_max is retained only as the historical mismatched-pooling diagnostic.
